scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw CSVs is feasible: the checker re-derives T_cross and η from the agent's data, comparing to the paper's reported transition temperature and algebraic decay exponent.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for T_sg/x and η used for scoring recomputed quantities.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: Fig.10(a) crossing at T_sg/x≈0.95(5) for x=0.35; η relation η=-1+0.98(T/x)^2 from Sec.IV/VB yields η≈-0.92 at T/x=0.286 and η≈-0.68 at T/x=0.571.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and figures; rounded to match paper's resolution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own estimates for the physical quantities being reproduced; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: Finite-size correlation-length ratio vs scaled temperature for x=0.35.
Overlap variance vs system size for selected low temperatures.
Derived spin-glass transition temperature and quasi-long-range order exponent.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the crossing temperature from xi_over_L_vs_T.csv and the decay exponent from q2_vs_N.csv, then compare against reference values with appropriate tolerances. The summary_results.json is used as a secondary check.
